silhouette.reason: The closer street-level hero shows dense brick tenements with water tanks, bulkheads and fire escapes breaking the roofline; cornices are thin and parapets mostly level.
fixes: deeper projecting cornices (0.4–0.6 m) and parapets of varied height on each building

proportions.reason: Storey heights vary between buildings; roofs within each row are still the same slab height in FRONT/SIDE. The street trees are now rounder crowns but still faceted polyhedra on thin trunks that barely show below the crown (hero.png foreground).
fixes: vary roof heights within each row
street trees with spreading irregular crowns and a visible trunk of ~0.3 m with a clear stem below the crown

materials.reason: Brick tones vary per building, windows read as framed grids, the asphalt has dashes, edge lines and worn patches; the sidewalk slabs lost the pale diagonal streaks that crossed them and the stucco facade lost the pale lines under each window row (hero.png), so both read cleaner. The faceted tree crowns still read as solid gumdrops and the roofs remain one flat colour each.
fixes: patches, gravel and vents on each roof membrane
break the tree crown outline with alpha leaf cards or several overlapping clumps so the facets do not read

detail.reason: Fire escapes, water tanks, cornice trims, sills, awnings and storefront doors now show at street level; some ground floors are still dark blank bands.
fixes: storefront glazing and doors on every street-facing ground floor

wear.reason: Sill streaks now vary in length per window, taper and some windows are clean (hero.png, the pale building right), but they are hard-edged geometric wedges rather than soft drips; still no grime gradient at street level or soot under the cornices.
fixes: soften the streak edges and break them into 2–3 thin runs instead of one wedge
grime gradient at street level and soot below cornices
patched roof membranes in varied greys

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 facades now keep their per-building red-brown brick, brownstone and pale stucco with the window grids, so the grey pop is gone; the rooftop water tanks and fire escapes drop out, so the roofline flattens at the switch.
fixes: keep the water tanks at LOD2 as one low-poly cylinder + cone each so the roofline survives the switch
